title: DAPS: Dependency-Aware Premise Selection for LLM Theorem Proving
abstract: arXiv:2610.41536v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based theorem proving in Lean 4 has advanced rapidly, but provers are difficult to leverage newly contributed lemmas, because retrieval skews toward popular foundational lemmas, leaving the right premises buried among hundreds of thousands of candidates. Existing neural selectors rank candidates by semantic similarity, with three intrinsic limitations: frequency-skewed retrieval, isolated pairwise ranking, and degradation on out-of-distribution queries such as competition problems and informal language. Given that mathematics is structured by dependencies rather than similarities, we restore this signal to both the training data and the model. We curate two underused dependency resources. We conduct the first systematic mining of 53 Lean Blueprint projects, a previously untapped corpus of 3,805 manually curated informal+formal nodes that capture rare, research-level premises absent from Mathlib4. translated_title: DAPS：面向LLM定理证明的依赖感知前提选择
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的Lean 4定理证明发展迅速，但证明器难以利用新贡献的引理，因为检索偏向于流行的基础引理，使得正确的前提被埋没在数十万个候选之中。现有的神经选择器按语义相似度对候选进行排序，存在三个内在局限：频率偏斜的检索、孤立的成对排序，以及在分布外查询（如竞赛题目和非正式语言）上的性能退化。鉴于数学是按依赖关系而非相似性来构建结构的，我们将这一信号重新引入训练数据和模型中。我们整理了两项未被充分利用的依赖资源。我们对53个Lean Blueprint项目进行了首次系统性挖掘，构建了一个此前未被开发的语料库，其中包含3,805个人工整理的非正式+正式节点，捕捉了Mathlib4中缺失的罕见研究级前提。我们进一步将其与提取的……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出DAPS方法，通过首次系统挖掘53个Lean Blueprint项目构建依赖关系语料库，将数学中的依赖结构信号引入前提选择的训练数据与模型中，克服了现有基于语义相似度的选择器在检索偏斜和分布外查询上的固有局限。
